content: Dear all, after discussions inside the Code of Conduct team, at the Mathlib maintainer meeting and with CSLib, we have decided to invite @Alexandre Rademaker as a member of the Code of Conduct team to represent the CSLib maintainer team. For many years, Alexandre has been an active participant in the Lean community on Zulip. CSLib has grown impressively in a short time, and with Alexandre in the team we aim to maintain a more complete overview over the discussions happening on and off this Zulip chat.
